text:
Maya: opened PR 501 to update 'audit export' wording + snippets. legal flagged a line that implies indefinite storage.
Ethan: can you paste the sentence?
Maya: current: "Redwood stores tenant audit events for compliance." Legal suggests we say retention is customer-configured.
Clara: propose: "Audit events are retained according to customer-configured retention and redaction policies."
Ethan: also fixed curl example (was missing Content-Type + query params). current example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports -d '{"scope":"tenant"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```
Clara: suggest:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports?format=jsonl&deidentify=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"tenant","start_time":"2025-03-01T00:00:00Z","end_time":"2025-03-31T23:59:59Z"}'
```
Maya: legal wants an explicit phrase: "subject to customer-configured retention and redaction settings" — covers legal-hold.
Ethan: add note: when deidentify=true fields matching PII patterns are pseudonymized using a one-way transform; see crypto controls.
Clara: updated filename example to include policy id: export-<tenant>-<policyid>-<ts>.jsonl and added link to retention API.
security-bot: docs PR #501 checks passed.
Maya: thanks — merging after tiny lint fix.
Ethan: +1, thanks everyone.
